scope.authorization: offline static audit only; no original code or binaries executed; no devices/network/firmware writes; AGY disabled
scope.inventory_coverage: all code in cam_cgi/ble/usb_ptp was read as bytes/AST/line markers; targeted semantic reads identified below; firmware_crypto semantic audit delegated elsewhere

conclusion.complete_s1m2_firmware_reverse_progress: No verified proprietary firmware plaintext, real camera RAM image, modern UPD0x200/selector3 consumer, or true image-loading producer found in this tool scope.
conclusion.actual_material: S5 host-side settings/protocol/USB/BLE tools and historical reports; direct program/Flash consumer still absent.
conclusion.new_high_value_fact: s5_ptp_raw.c sends an uninitialized command array; its by-construction read-only/exact-container claim is false for the delivered source.
not_proven: runtime effects of any packaged script

findings.title: C原始PTP客户端发送未初始化缓冲
findings.conclusion: ptp()声明cmd后未赋length/type/opcode/TID/params就WritePipeTO；op/params/g_tid从未构造发送包。源码不支持其精确长度/白名单请求断言，保存二进制与此源码的对应关系未知。收包也未匹配事务号/数据操作码，OpenSession只看有没有响应，不看0x2001。不可自动运行。
findings.value_for_complete_firmware_reverse: 没有有效可复现的固件或RAM读取请求，更没有消费0x200目录的代码

findings.title: 默认安全Campaign实际枚举动作/写入类接口
findings.conclusion: 默认phase A不需confirm，却遍历setsetting/camctrl/editcmd/camcmd/stream/senddata/endsenddata等及delete/shot/rec等动作词；请求未证明不会改变状态。A-G标签、GET和getstate健康检查均不能证明只读/零风险；F调用访问申请、升级模式门控，G创建和中止上传状态。
findings.value_for_complete_firmware_reverse: 词表枚举不是实际ROM/RAM读取消费者；仅可保留历史原始响应作线索

findings.title: BLE纯只读总述与配对写入矛盾
findings.conclusion: TOOLS把整个BLE组称纯只读；ble_pair实际写通知描述符/订阅及UUID、friendly name，并读取配对网络资料。ble_scan/ble_read会连接设备；连接/配对状态不等于零副作用。
findings.value_for_complete_firmware_reverse: 客户端会话/配对线索；INITIAL_INFORM会话混淆参数不是固件AES/OTP密钥，未提供主系统明文

findings.title: USB探针包含真实越界写/故意挂死且无单独批准门
findings.conclusion: usb_oob不是只读：detach/claim后发越界SET_INTERFACE控制写，再读；s5_ptp_dump.m的fuzz含未知操作码、lenprobe故意长度不匹配，按mode直接执行，没有confirm gate。不存在读操作码保证设备安全的推论。
findings.value_for_complete_firmware_reverse: 故障/弱字节响应不能等于可靠相机RAM转储；本轮没有执行验证

findings.title: 枚举接受条件包含未知错误/空结果
findings.conclusion: api_enum仅排除err_param/error，异常和其他错误可能进LIVE；enum_videoquality采用4项错误黑名单，err_reject/err_busy/EMPTY/?等可判accepted；enum_vq2还可将错误读回(非BASELINE)判REACHABLE。必须将传输成功、result==ok、匹配读回、实际媒体输出逐项区分。
findings.value_for_complete_firmware_reverse: 不能由这些汇总指标推出隐藏功能或新的固件处理链

findings.title: 恢复并非用户真实基线且存在仅注释恢复
findings.conclusion: enum_videoquality读取base却恢复硬编码mp4_50p_28mbps；enum_vq2亦恢复该常量；enum_video_use结尾仅有restore注释；hidden_features.restore强制standard/mov/C4K等默认。probe_format_slots保存原字段且finally恢复较好，但只打印读回/片段，未断言整包回到b0。
findings.value_for_complete_firmware_reverse: 可借鉴对照思路，不构成可逆性证明，也不能用于S1M2当前设置

findings.title: persist_quality的dry run仍写设置并在修改后备份
findings.conclusion: confirm只控制flash提交：125行以前已经setsetting，若读取失败/拒绝等没有还原；备份135–138保存的是修改后的blob而非blob_before，不能恢复原质量。container_switch同样先改设置再备份，--persist直接调用上传帮助函数。
findings.value_for_complete_firmware_reverse: 数据层配置改写不解密专有固件，也不支持安全移植其他型号

findings.title: 配置restore实际是固定目标重写
findings.conclusion: persist.restore下载当前配置后强制ntsc/MOV/0x9b再重算checksum和上传，不是还原历史原包；仅固定65533长度/单字节checksum，没有机型版本匹配。AC只是文档假设。
findings.value_for_complete_firmware_reverse: 读取/写回相机设置块，不能称Flash系统或RAM读取；S1M2配置9MB布局不同

findings.title: 配置上传返回ok不足以证明完整提交和恢复
findings.conclusion: 帮助函数在丢响应时可重发块，未证明幂等；requestsenddata响应未检查；非ok断言NOT committed与物理结果无必然对应，cmd_verify只显示几个固定字段，没有整包与目标精确比较。备份文件存在不等于恢复成功。
findings.value_for_complete_firmware_reverse: 分块链可作客户端消费者研究，但不提供机内固件解码或加载生产者

findings.title: 升级预言机将返回码直接解释成签名覆盖
findings.conclusion: upload Phase I把ok解释不覆盖版本、err_reject解释ECDSA门、err_fw_same解释读取inner字段；单一响应无法排除传输、版本、格式/认证/异步失败等原因。回归getinfo(allmenu)未核实实际镜像和重启状态，不证明升级写入。README所谓可重刷恢复/不是变砖缺具体已验证恢复能力。
findings.value_for_complete_firmware_reverse: 发送修改固件有真实写入风险，只保留过去原始日志，不作为获得固件明文的方法

findings.title: ROMBACKUP报告把用途升级成确定覆盖范围
findings.conclusion: 作者照片/列表最多支持S5服务菜单与灰色ROM BACKUP存在。所引S1M2维修步骤未定义导出地址/格式/长度；不能确定只含校准、必不含程序，更不能确定MC801 OTP密钥位置或离线绝不可能。灰态原因、纯机身UI、私有Tether归属都未以实际消费者或状态对照闭合。
findings.value_for_complete_firmware_reverse: 缺同款调整程序/备份样本/调用链，不是新的完整系统读取入口；范围保持未知

findings.title: OOB读探针没有可靠地址映射或完整RAM消费者
findings.conclusion: oob_read_probe只在固定PID尝试GET_INTERFACE单字节请求；由非零/变化字节推断内核读出，未核对运行内核、接口绑定、数据源或地址映射。文稿直接声称S1M2已实机POC不由此代码证明。当前源的f_fs=get_alt和主USB请求层关系还须另审。
findings.value_for_complete_firmware_reverse: 最多条件性的驱动缺陷线索，不是 arbitrary physical read 或完整RAM导出

findings.title: 标准库/白名单客户端声明不完整
findings.conclusion: TOOLS称所有Python仅标准库，但USB脚本导入usb1/usb.core；Python PTP客户端detach驱动/claim接口，事务匹配TID但不核对DATA opcode，公开transaction/send_command无读取操作码白名单，close不reattach驱动。仅当前调用序列可核对，不能由类名或注释保证只读。
findings.value_for_complete_firmware_reverse: 协议结构可参考；完整工具成熟度和S1M2兼容性未验证

usable_offline_only: Raw existing responses and logs can be parsed with independently reviewed code; preserve capture dates/status/model.
Setting blob/checksum and protocol structure are references, not new firmware decoding.
BLE source/UUID list provides client-side pairing sequence; pair script itself writes and stored evidence may include network credentials.
Service screenshots support visible menu/state only; use same-model adjustment consumer or original backup to determine range.

not_authorized_to_run.all_external_tools: This review authorizes no execution; even legitimate readers communicate with devices and need separate scope.
particularly_unsafe: raw C PTP sender with uninitialized buffer
not_authorized_to_run.dry_run_caveat: persist_quality dry run already mutates live setting; do not equate missing --confirm with no device effect

reference_boundary.manual_correction_used: Already verified local manual review says ROMBACKUP scope/format/byte count undefined and specifically retracts only-calibration exclusion; manual PDF not re-extracted in this subtask.
reference_boundary.future_research: Locate actual same-model consumer/load map or independently sourced real ROM/RAM image; do not expand speculative writes or key enumeration.
